title: finding(plugin-dashboard): a dashboard block on a page never loads its dataset-bound widgets — DashboardRenderer reads dataSource only from props, and SchemaRenderer injects none
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (a) (a declared, holdable block that cannot work on its host). Reader: triage first (route and grade).

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from objectui#10778's dev report (`5857782762`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`) and the contract review of PR objectui#10809.

## Measured (the dev's runtime probe; the served page was NOT measured)

- The probe rendered a `dashboard` block whose widgets are dataset-bound (bar / table / pivot) through the real `SchemaRenderer`, under `SchemaRendererProvider`, with a `queryDataset`-capable adapter and no host `dataSource` prop. That is `PageView`'s render path.
- It called `queryDataset` 0 times and painted "This data source does not support dataset queries."
- Cause: `DashboardRenderer` reads `dataSource` only from its props. `SchemaRenderer` strips the schema key and injects no adapter prop, and `DatasetWidget` gets its adapter only from `DashboardRenderer`. The `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` CHANGELOG records the no-adapter state as a deliberate visible alert for SDUI hosts, but a page holding a `dashboard` block has an adapter in `useSchemaContext`.

## Why it matters

A `dashboard` block is holdable on a stored page (`PageComponentSchema.type` admits any registered key). Its dataset widgets show an "unsupported" alert instead of data, although the page has a capable adapter.

## Direction (for triage to confirm)

- `DashboardRenderer` (or `DatasetWidget`) falls back to the ambient `useSchemaContext` data source when no prop is given, the same way the page-embeddable object blocks take theirs.
- Then the widgets get a bus reader (the objectui#10778 shape) in the same PR.
- Pin a `dashboard` block with a dataset widget on the page path: data renders, and a re-read follows `notifyDataChanged`.

Not a blocker of objectui#10519: these widgets load nothing on the page path today, so removing the remount cannot make them staler.
